$schema_comment: ADS tool registry. Keep tool_id stable across clients and generate this file via scripts/sync-tools.py.

tools.title: blocked-triager
tools.description: Classify an ADS task situation as CONTINUE, NEEDS_CONTEXT, BLOCKED, or shared-change-request escalation, and optionally draft the request file.

tools.title: ADS Check Stale Knowledge
tools.description: Check whether ADS memory objects are stale relative to review windows and references.

tools.title: ADS Context Pack
tools.description: Generate a CLI context pack from a task and optional handoff.

tools.title: ADS Doctor
tools.description: Check ADS bootstrap completeness, task/handoff alignment, and tool drift.

tools.title: ADS Evidence Capture
tools.description: Execute a verification command and emit a standard ADS evidence table row.

tools.title: ADS Handoff Draft
tools.description: Generate a handoff draft from task metadata and the current git diff.

tools.title: handoff-writer
tools.description: Write a concrete ADS handoff markdown file from a task, current git diff, and handoff metadata defaults.

tools.title: ADS Health Report
tools.description: Generate a minimal collaboration health report for ADS workspaces.

tools.title: ADS Init
tools.description: Scaffold the minimal ADS workspace into another repository.

tools.title: ADS Knowledge Pack
tools.description: Build a minimal knowledge pack from task, handoff, and memory objects.

tools.title: ADS Resume
tools.description: Build a resume-oriented context summary from task, handoff, change, and constitution artifacts.

tools.title: spec-syncer
tools.description: Infer impacted ADS specs from a task, changed paths, and linked change proposal, then optionally write spec-delta.md.

tools.title: ADS Sync Tools
tools.description: Synchronize toolset entries from ADS script tools and skill manifests.

tools.title: task-decomposer
tools.description: Split an ADS change proposal into role-oriented task drafts with related paths and parent_change_id already filled.

tools.title: ADS Validate
tools.description: Validate task, handoff, memory, request, QA, pattern, spec, and toolset artifacts.

tools.title: competitive-plan-validator
tools.description: 对产品方案做当前竞品扫描与内部模拟分析，输出扫描记录、分析报告和产品增强建议。

tools.title: example_skill
tools.description: 示例：对 ADS manifest 字段的占位说明。真实技能请替换描述与参数。
